title: FAQ
description: Frequently asked questions about Mash & Burn Co., including ordering, sizing, care, custom work, and workshop process.

data.body:
## Do You Release Collections?

No. I release projects when they are ready.

## Is Everything Made By Hand?

Everything is cut, sewn, finished, packed, or handled by me in small batches.

## Do You Take Custom Work?

Sometimes. Bespoke work depends on timing, fit, and whether the project belongs in the workshop.

## Can I Visit The Workshop?

Not currently. The workshop is private, but the work is documented through projects and Bench Notes.

## How Do I Know What Is Available?

Check Current Work and On The Bench. If something is available, it will say so.
